highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.3 Preview 1 fixes Ahead-of-Time deployment and refreshes bundled native dependencies.
highlights_body: It also corrects Linux ARM64 font configuration and adds native binary hardening for supported Windows and Linux builds.

bullets.detail: Fixes a crash when publishing with IlcDisableReflection enabled.
Adds the required fontconfig runtime library to the cross-compilation sysroot.
Updates libpng, libwebp, libexpat, and brotli while enabling native binary mitigation flags.

contributor_summaries.sshumakov: Added mitigation flags for the Windows and Linux native libraries

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: Preview 1 delivers Ahead-of-Time and Linux ARM64 fixes with refreshed native dependencies.
